name: Bauhaus and its Sites in Weimar, Dessau and Bernau
description: This World Heritage group spans three German towns: Weimar, Dessau and Bernau near Berlin. It preserves the buildings of the Bauhaus, the design school that ran only from 1919 to 1933 yet reshaped modern architecture. You can see its sleek Dessau school building, the Masters' Houses, the experimental Haus Am Horn and a trade union school with clean, functional lines.
